title: DeepSeek R1 vs Kimi K2 vs Qwen3 Coder vs GLM 4.5 - Head-to-Head Testing!
summary: Informal side-by-side tests of Kimi K2, GLM 4.5, Qwen3 Coder and DeepSeek on a web-OS prompt, roleplay and a Python FPS.

assertions.quote: every single one of these is something that is open source ... All of the results were acceptable

verdicts.note: Qwen3-Coder, Kimi K2 and GLM 4.5/4.6 posted strong SWE-bench and Terminal-Bench results in 2025 while generally trailing frontier closed models.

assertions.quote: All I did was paste in the actual error message. And for three of the four here they went ahead and just immediately fixed it

verdicts.note: Agent benchmarks and practice consistently show verifiable feedback (tests, compilers) is the main driver of agent success.
